messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — p95 latency for Qwen-70B quant4 in eu-central (mi300) jumped ~2.8x vs us-west (h100). Only difference seems to be pos-enc kernel path when GQA is enabled. Anyone seen this?
sam: Saw something similar yesterday but thought it was batching. Can you paste the perf snippet?
maria: Dropping the perf summary from the qbench run below — short and noisy but shows the pattern.
perf-bot: ```
model: qwen-70b-quant4
region: eu-central (mi300)  p50:  92ms  p95: 420ms  throughput: 28 t/s
region: us-west   (h100)   p50:  86ms  p95: 150ms  throughput: 32 t/s
flags: gqa=on rope=rotary kernel_fallthrough=enabled
observed: kernel selection fell back to slow_posenc_v2 at seq=2048
```
sam: Interesting — fallback at seq=2048. Are we shipping ctxsplit/prefetch flags differently in the EU pool?
kevin: We rolled a kernel-selection heuristic in eu for mi300 yesterday (PR #5012) that biases away from rope-optimized kernels for non-rope models. @anita did you own that deploy?
anita: Yep, I shipped the heuristic tweak to prefer "generic_posenc" to avoid observed accuracy drift on a small set of evals. Didn't expect a big perf hit on quant4. I can revert and run a quick canary.
maria: Additional datapoint: toggling GQA off in the same EU pool drops p95 down to ~160ms. So this looks like a kernel routing interaction with the GQA flag rather than batching.
sam: Can you post exact repro steps?
maria: Repro (simple curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Region: eu-central" -d '{"model":"qwen-70b-quant4","inputs":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":2048,"gqa":true}'
```
then same with "gqa":false.
kevin: Let's bisect kernel options: run 20k requests split across seq lengths 512/1024/2048 comparing kernels: generic_posenc, slow_posenc_v2, rotary_optimized on both mi300 and h100 in eu/us. I'll queue a job.
perf-bot: Queued job 2056789200 — qbench/posenc-interop-eu-us (20k samples). ETA ~2h.
maria: FYI: Llama and Mistral show different behavior here — Llama (rope native) isn't hitting the slow path, so cross-model kernel interaction will be useful to capture.
anita: I'll revert the heuristic in EU and spin a canary (deploy id 1123) to confirm impact. Will also add a short test to catch perf regressions for quantized models. cc @sam @kevin
sam: Thanks — if the bounce persists after revert, we should consider an SLO-aware auto-fallback: prefer faster kernel when model is quantized and latency SLO is at risk.
kevin: Filing follow-up INF ticket INF-9243 to track: include perf logs, qbench job id, and canary results. Assigning to eng-ml/posenc.
maria: OK will monitor the canary and post results. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for eu-mi300 heuristic revert (deploy/1123) — monitor eng-oncall for alerts.
